svg.title: Prince of the Chariot of the Winds: King of Swords · Air of Air (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Air of Air; rules from 20° Capricorn to 20° Aquarius, as Book T counts. Its ring: number 15 in Book T's order, with its part of the zodiac lit. The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1795880674375-k1thm83kjm.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0).
